guidebook.intro: Proverbs, **carolok**, carry the wisdom of elders. In this unit the Ganda proverbs are said in Acholi.

tips.title: Tyen lok ne ngo?
body: Ask the meaning of a proverb with **Tyen lok ne ngo?** (what is its root?). Introduce one with **Calo gin ma giwaco** (as they say).

tips.title: Proverbs in Acholi
body: **Manok manok pongo aduku** (little by little fills the basket) and **Lak ma tye kacel kayo ringo** (teeth that are together bite the meat) carry Ganda wisdom in Acholi words. Acholi has its own proverbs too, many about patience, unity and respect for elders.

culture.title: Speaking in proverbs
body: Elders show their skill by answering with a proverb instead of a plain sentence. Using one well, at the right moment, earns respect.
